title: Sharp Bounds on Ground State Energy of the SYK Model
summary: We study the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) Hamiltonian $H_{\operatorname{SYK}}$ on $n$ Majorana modes with $k$-body interactions, and prove that $\mathbb{E}\|H_{\operatorname{SYK}}\|_{\operatorname{op}} = (1 - o(1))\cdot\sqrt{2n}/k$ for super-constant $k\leq o(\sqrt{n})$, where the expectation is over the disorder variables in the Hamiltonian. This confirms predictions due to Garcia-Garcia, Jia and Verbaarschot and answers a question posed by Feng, Tian, and Wei. Our results extend to the sparse SYK Hamiltonian.
